entries.text: Let's go, buddy. Schooltime.
entries.translation: 走吧 伙计 该上学了

entries.text: Oh, and Gloria, if you want to get together with the girls later,

entries.text: I could just, you know, watch the football game or something.
entries.translation: 我可以自己看看橄榄球赛什么的

entries.text: I'm not talking to you.
entries.translation: 我不是和你说话

entries.text: are those French toaster sticks from?

entries.text: - That's today? - See.

entries.text: It's the Ohio State game.

entries.text: So? Everybody can watch.

entries.text: I don't like watching the game with people who don't know the game.

entries.text: People talk.

entries.text: You talk at my football games.

entries.text: For one thing, it's called soccer.

entries.text: Your team scored two goals all season.

entries.text: I'm not taking a big risk.

entries.text: How much of this did you drink?

entries.text: Give me a break. I have to climb a rope today.

entries.text: - Hey, Mom. - Yeah?

entries.text: Can I have $40 for lunch?

entries.text: Forty dollars?
- I also need a book for school. - What book?

entries.text: Do you have any idea what a bad liar you are?

entries.text: I'd be more worried that

entries.text: she couldn't come up with a single book title.

entries.text: Luke, come on. We're late.

entries.text: Mmm, there's a first- inside out and backwards.

entries.text: At least it isn't zipped into his...

entries.text: Oh. There it is.
entries.translation: 好吧 真塞进去了

entries.text: Well, there's book smart, and then there's street smart.
entries.translation: 有人是"读书大智慧" 也有人是"市井小聪明"

entries.text: Yeah, and then there's Luke.
entries.translation: 没错 卢克属于第三类怪胎

entries.text: Oh, he's just... He's just curious. That's all.
entries.translation: 他只是 他只是好奇心重 仅此而已

entries.text: He's got this almost scientific mind...
entries.translation: 他有着科学家的头脑

entries.text: with a thirst for knowledge.
entries.translation: 以及对知识的渴望

entries.text: He's like this little Einstein.
entries.translation: 他像小爱因斯坦一样

entries.text: Some people ask, "Why?"
entries.translation: 有些人会问"为什么"

entries.text: I ask "Why?" a lot.
entries.translation: 我经常问"为什么"

entries.text: We're at the ten. We're at the five.
entries.translation: 我们在十码区 现在是五码区

entries.text: I'm quite adept at Japanese flower arrangement-

entries.text: ikebana-

entries.translation: 而且我曾是伊利诺伊大学的首发进攻内锋

entries.text: Surprise.
entries.translation: 惊讶吧

entries.text: - I don't like football. - You know what?

entries.translation: 我认为维持恋情的一方面

entries.text: Do you think I really loved home pickle-making?

entries.text: Yeah, 'cause you did.
entries.translation: 是的 因为你确实喜欢

entries.text: For a week,
entries.translation: 就喜欢一周

entries.text: until we became the weird guys who gave everybody pickles.
entries.translation: 到后来别人都以为我们是到处送腌菜的怪胎

entries.text: Oh, thank you, Marvin, for inviting us into your lovely home.
entries.translation: 马文 谢谢邀请我们到你温馨的家来

entries.text: Here. Would you care for a sack of pickles?
entries.translation: 给你 请收下这包腌菜

entries.text: It was charming.
entries.translation: 你真可爱

entries.text: We were picklers, Mitchell.

entries.text: Stay home with your little jagged scissors.

entries.text: I hate it when people do that.
entries.translation: 我讨厌别人那么做

entries.text: Do you, Mitchell? Do you?

entries.text: No problem. We'll be right down. Thanks.

entries.text: Hey, honey. What's up?

entries.text: Oh, geez. Is he okay?

entries.text: - Where are you? - I'm showing a house.

entries.text: What house?
entries.translation: 什么房子

entries.text: I'm golfing.
entries.translation: 我在打高尔夫球

entries.text: I bet it was that Durkas kid.
entries.translation: 我猜是那个叫德卡斯的小孩

entries.text: I hate that kid.
entries.translation: 我讨厌那个小孩

entries.text: and Luke just fought back.

entries.text: Shh. The parents are probably in there.

entries.text: Like that never happened to him?

entries.text: Come on.

entries.text: What are you doing here?

entries.translation: 这两个笨蛋在一起打架

entries.text: - What? - Could've been worse.
entries.translation: -什么 -幸好是你啊

entries.text: So what happened?

entries.text: and shoving on the playground.
entries.translation: 和斗殴的事情

entries.text: By the time a teacher separated them,

entries.text: - Shut up! - Okay, okay.

entries.text: I'm getting the sense that you're all related, uh, somehow.

entries.text: So it's probably best if you work this out at home...

entries.text: so the boys can go back to class, okay?

entries.text: [Passwater 意译为递水]
Look, I wouldn't worry. They're good kids.

entries.translation: 只是当某个孩子比较怪异时 会有点难处理

entries.text: - Yes. - Yes.
entries.translation: -是的 -是的

entries.text: "Yes."

entries.text: and dresses like a count.

entries.text: Football.
